insight: Published a public 'ethical framework for AI music' and pays artists royalties when their trained 'DNA' models are used.
name: Soundverse
tagline: AI music generator and assistant with a marketplace for artist-trained models.
description: Soundverse generates full tracks from text prompts and bundles music tools — stem separation, lyric writing, and a chat-style 'assistant' — into one studio. Its 'DNA' program lets artists train their own AI models and earn when others create with them. Available on the web, iOS, Android, and via an enterprise API.

modelSupport.notes: Runs its own generative music models; artists can train custom 'DNA' models.

edge: Pairs text-to-music with an artist-model marketplace and a stated ethical-licensing framework built on creator consent and royalty payouts.
pros: Artists can train and monetize models
cons: Smaller and newer than Suno or Udio
Best features need a paid plan

references.title: Soundverse sets out its 'ethical framework for AI music'
